title: Linux server operations basics
description: Catch the Linux problems that take a host or service down: kernel panics, the OOM killer, filesystems flipping read-only, disk and inode exhaustion, crashing processes, and CPU and memory saturation. Uses the standard Unix and Linux add-on.

splunkbaseApps.displayName: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux

requiredData.notes: Enable the cpu.sh, vmstat.sh, and df.sh scripted inputs and the /var/log/messages (or syslog) monitor in Splunk_TA_nix.

industrySources.control: Four golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation
Kernel memory management: OOM killer as 'critical process gone'

curationNotes: Skips UC-1.1.20 reboot detection (needs a custom linux:boot_id collector) and custom systemd collectors.
UC-1.1.2 is bronze depth with no wave; lift before publishing.
